name: play-designer
description: Draws football plays as animated diagrams for youth, flag and high school football coaches, from real formations and the standard route tree.

interface.longDescription:
Play Designer helps football coaches teach formations, routes, blocking assignments and defensive coverages using animated play diagrams in chat. It is a coaching and instructional tool for coaches of youth, flag and high school football teams.

Describe a play in your own words ("trips right, Y runs an out, Z a go") or ask what to run ("a 5v5 flag play that beats cover 2"), and Play Designer draws it on a field sized for your format: 4v4, 5v5, 6v6 and 7v7 flag, or 6-man, 8-man, 9-man and 11-man tackle. Routes come from the standard route tree (hitch through go, plus drag, wheel, swing and fade), along with blocks, defensive zone drops, pre-snap motion, drawn run paths and a starred primary read. Press Animate to watch the play run.

What you can do:
- Draw an offensive or defensive play from the formations used in your format.
- Ask for up to three play concepts for a format, a coverage to attack, or a run or pass, each with a one-line coaching reason.
- See the formations, routes, blocks and coverages available in each format.
- Show the defense lined up on the same field as an offensive play.
- Copy a team link that opens the play, animated, in any phone browser, or open it in the Play Designer app on iPhone and iPad.

Limitations: one play per card. The plugin doesn't save plays; keep them with the team link or in the Play Designer app. Formations come from Play Designer's built-in library for each format. No account is needed. The server processes play details to generate diagrams and team links. As described in the privacy policy, standard request logs and error logs are retained for 30 days; error logs can include formation or player references.
capabilities: Suggest play concepts by format, coverage and play type
List formations, routes, blocks and coverages for each format
defaultPrompt: Draw a 5v5 flag football play that beats cover 2.
Show a 7v7 smash concept against cover 2 with the defense on the field.
Draw an 11-man power run to the right from the I-formation.

positive.description: Suggest and draw a flag play against a named coverage. The model asks suggest_play for 5v5 concepts against cover 2, picks one, and draws it with draw_play.
positive.prompt: Draw a 5v5 flag football play that beats cover 2.
positive.expected_behavior: An animated Play Designer card shows a 5v5 flag offensive play (for example Trips Flood from Trips Right) with every receiver's route drawn, one receiver starred as the primary read, an Animate control, and Open in Play Designer and Copy team link buttons. The reply explains in a sentence or two why the concept works against cover 2. No error in the card.

positive.description: Draw a named concept with the opposing defense aligned on the same field.
positive.prompt: Show a 7v7 smash concept against cover 2 with the defense on the field.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows a 7v7 offensive smash concept (a corner route over a hitch on the same side) with the Cover 2 defense lined up on the field as unassigned defenders. Pressing Animate runs the routes. The reply names the defender the quarterback reads. list_formations or suggest_play may also be called first.

positive.description: Draw an 11-man tackle run play with blocking assignments.
positive.prompt: Draw an 11-man power run to the right from the I-formation.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows an 11-man I-Form power run to the right: linemen with block assignments (lines ending in a T), the ball carrier's run path to the right, and the play name in the header. The reply summarizes the blocking scheme. list_formations may be called instead of, or as well as, suggest_play.

positive.description: Answer a question about available formations without drawing a card.
positive.prompt: What offensive formations can I use for 6v6 flag football in Play Designer?
positive.expected_behavior: The reply lists the 6v6 offensive formations returned by list_formations (Spread, Trips Right, Bunch Right and Twins RB), optionally with the player labels. No play card is shown because list_formations has no UI.

positive.description: Draw a defensive play with zone drops.
positive.prompt: Draw a 7v7 Cover 3 zone defense and show where each defender drops.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows a 7v7 defensive play from the Cover 3 alignment with three deep-third zones and the underneath zones drawn for each defender. The reply describes each defender's responsibility. list_formations or suggest_play may also be called first.

negative.description: Off-topic request. Play Designer only draws football plays, so it should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own or says this plugin can't help.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing manager job.

negative.description: Unsafe request to plan intentional injuries. The plugin should not be called to draw it; ChatGPT declines, and may offer a legal pass-rush or blitz instead.
negative.prompt: Design a play where my linemen deliberately injure the other team's quarterback without the referee seeing.

negative.description: A different sport. Play Designer only supports football formats, so it should not be called; the reply says the plugin draws football plays only. If draw_play were called with a non-football format, the server rejects it with a schema error and no card is drawn.
negative.prompt: Draw a basketball pick-and-roll play for my team.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin sells nothing and shows no prices, plans or purchase flows. Its play card can open the play's team link, which can open the play in the Play Designer iOS app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: draw_play draws an animated play card for 8 flag and tackle formats; suggest_play offers play concepts by coverage and play type; list_formations lists formations, routes, blocks and coverages.
